coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 9 ground-truth variable categories: evaluation on WikiText-2 at sequence length 2048, an unquantized 16-bit baseline, 4/3/2-bit weights, all four quantization methods, perplexity, and numerical failure monitoring.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses symmetric rather than asymmetric quantization and varies granularity instead of fixing per-column quantization. Replaces LLAMA2-70B with LLaMA-3-8B. Although weight-only quantization is specified, FP16/BF16 are treated interchangeably and FP16 KV caches are not explicitly fixed. Adds datasets, metrics, and experimental factors outside the target design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the Table 7 results and conclusions about QuaRot-GPTQ's low-bit improvements, RTN failures, limited QuaRot-RTN stabilization, and the 70B W2 perplexity reduction from 25.30 to 5.60.
